Item Name: Seal of Hleran
Description: An heirloom from the Hleran family tomb, awarded for uncovering the family's onetime alliance with the Ashlanders of Ald'ruhn.

Item Name: Griskild's Tenderizer
Description: Lady Laurent presented this evil-looking mace to you in token of your mad adventure in the shrine of Bal Fell.

Item Name: Redoran Honor Gauntlets
Description: Councilor Eris hired you to find his daughter Veya. For your help, he gave you these House Redoran gauntlets.

Item Name: A bow claimed from the Warclaws mercenaries at Kudanant Mine.
An assassin's helm, given to you by Veya Releth for your part in looking into her brother Ulran's death.
An axe nearly as venomous as House Redoran's inner dealings. Naryu Virian gave it to you for protecting the Morag Tong's honor.
Neria Lerano gave you this well-used Hlaalu girdle to thank you for your help in creating her father's memory stone.
Waterlogged Strong Box
Description: Why, it's your strong box! For some reason, things seemed like you might never see it again. It's heavier than you remember, though.

Item Name: Nirith's Bulwark of the Defiler
Description: A robust Daedric shield, awarded by Tythis Nirith for your efforts to find his sister in the Forgotten Wastes.

Item Name: Kwama-Cutter
Description: Kwama-egg miners avoid killing their insectoid livestock, but sometimes riled kwama warriors leave them no choice.

Set: Revus's Spare Staff of the War Maiden
Item Name: Just the right size and shape to pry kwama-eggs from their heaps. Awarded for saving the egg mine of Gnisis.
Theyo Prevette gave you these blessed ghost-hunter leggings for your help in cleansing Valenvaryon.
Chain-Breaker Gauntlets
Description: The Orc smuggler Nakhul gave you these heavy gauntlets for rescuing slaves hiding from the Camonna Tong.

Item Name: Kwama-Hide Cops
Description: These tough hide shoulder pieces were your reward for putting an end to a dangerous scheme in the Matus-Akin Egg Mine.

Item Name: Tribal Helm of the Defiler
Description: You earned this helm for slaying the "Ruddy Man" attacking pilgrims near Molag Mar, thus proving an Ashlander tribe's innocence.

Item Name: Artificer's Coat of the War Maiden
Description: The mage Neramo found this Dwemer coat in the ruins of Nchuleftingth. Still supple after all these centuries!

Item Name: Robe of Ambition
Description: A fine Telvanni robe, which Sun-in-Shadow gave you in gratitude for your help in gaining her freedom.

Item Name: You earned this ring by helping Sun-in-Shadow climb the ranks in House Telvanni.
An excellent pair of boots that once belonged to Sun-in-Shadow's enemy, Ralasa Delvi. She won't be needing them anymore.
A handsome dagger with a handle made of pearly red star-shell, the price of a slave's freedom.
Governor's Ring of the War Maiden
Description: Deminah Salvi, the new governor of Seyda Neen, awarded you this ring for exposing slavers on Firemoth Island.

Item Name: The Scarlet Necklace
Description: The Scarlet Judge gave you this enchanted necklace for your help in bringing down the corrupt magistrate of Suran.

Item Name: Let this smock serve as a reminder that it's rarely a good idea to harass a talented alchemist.
Magister's Exquisite Gloves
Description: Beautiful Telvanni gloves, awarded for paying Sun-in-Shadow's debt to Magister Gothren.

Item Name: Dark Staff of the War Maiden
Description: A fiery staff of Daedric origin. Mistress Dratha gave it to you in payment for helping her bargain for immortality.

Item Name: Tear-Stained Staff of the War Maiden
Description: Sun-in-Shadow gave you this staff for helping Eoki at Vassamsi Mine. Her relationship with Eoki will not be so easy to fix, however.

Item Name: Blackstone Hammer of the War Maiden
Description: An ebony weapon is a suitable reward for getting to the bottom of the Vassir-Didanat Mine mystery.

Item Name: Pauldrons of the Warrior-Poet
Description: Bestowed by Narsis Dren's apprentice for your part in the famous adventurer's plundering-er, exploration-of the Veloth Ancestral Tomb.

Item Name: Canon's Staff of the Tribunal
Description: Lord Vivec himself gave you this frosty staff for aiding Canon Llevule at the Andrano Ancestral Tomb and assisting him with a divination ritual.

Item Name: You traveled all over Vvardenfell in Lord Vivec's service. It seems fitting that he rewarded you with a good pair of boots.
You earned these Ashlander greaves by exposing Chodala as a failed Nerevarine in the council at.
A mighty weapon awarded by Lord Vivec in token of your victory over the false Nerevarine Chodala in the ruins of Kaushtarari.
Awarded for restoring Lord Vivec's power in time for him to stop the moonlet Baar Dau from crushing Vivec City.
In gratitude for recovering his stolen divine energy from the Clockwork City, Lord Vivec rewarded you with one of his favorite swords.
This ornate breastplate marks you as the Champion of Vivec, the Warrior-Poet of the Tribunal.
Awarded by Librarian Bradyn for your assistance in collecting a rubbing of an inscription in the Othrelas Ancestral Tomb.
You helped Librarian Bradyn find the Lost Library of Andule. In thanks, he gave you this ancient Dark Elf cuirass.
Dratha's Epaulettes of the War Maiden
Description: Llayne Sadri, Mouth of Mistress Dratha, gave you these epaulettes as a token of her mistress's gratitude.

Item Name: Stromgruf's Ensorcelled Pants
Description: A token of thanks from the alchemist Nerise Venim. Her hireling Stromgruf won't be needing pants for a while.

Boss/Quest: Between a Rock and a Whetstone
Item Name: Sharp's Angler's Bounty
Description: A paper-wrapped parcel of fresh fish, bait to catch more fish, and a recipe scavenged by Sharp to make use of all those fish.

Item Name: Sugar-Hemp Sash
Description: Awarded for dealing with bandits and an illicit moon-sugar crop in the cave of Zainsipilu.
